description: This Java class, OpenApiConfig, configures the OpenAPI metadata for the Petclinic API, setting up API information, contact details, and external documentation for Swagger UI integration.

classes.name: OpenApiConfig
classes.description: Configuration class that defines a Bean for the OpenAPI object used by Swagger UI for API documentation.

methods.name: petclinicOpenAPI
methods.description: Creates and returns an OpenAPI object configured with API info, contact, and external documentation.
